The '''Foxar system''' was a [[Wild Space/Legends|Wild Space]] [[Star system/Legends|star system]].<ref name="EAOC" /> The [[Outer Region Foxar Scout Base]] was located in the system.<ref name="A Typical Survey" /><ref name="Planetnamia" />

==Behind the scenes==
The Foxar system was first mentioned in the [[2009]] reference book ''[[The Essential Atlas]]'', written by [[Jason Fry]] and [[Daniel Wallace]], which placed the system in grid square N-3.<ref name="TEA" />
